newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's GMD to work on Marcatel network.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's GMD to work on Marcatel network.

text.p: Mexican construction firm Grupo Mexicano de Desarrollo (GMD) said on Tuesday it would work with Siemens AG to lay the fibre-optic network of Marcatel, one of Mexico's new long-distance telephone companies.

GMD said in a statement that its work would be concentrated within the so-called "Golden Triangle" of Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey, the three largest cities in Mexico, which will be connected to the United States through Marcatel.
Marcatel is a joint venture formed by the Mexican firm Radio Beep and the U.S. companies Westell Technologies Inc and IXC Communications Inc.
The first phase of the network, which will require a $21.6 million investment, will cover 868 miles (1,400 km) from Reynosa on the northern border with Texas to Mexico City.
GMD said it would finance 20 percent of the job, with the rest being covered by Siemens.
